dedupe_keys.name: standard spectral ratios ssr on earthquake recordings of stations of the 6n network during the activities of the emersito ingv emergency group in ancona italy following the 2022 mw 5 5 costa marchigiana pesarese earthquake

description: Italy’s Istituto Nazionale di Geofisica e Vulcanologia publishes standard spectral ratios for earthquake recordings from the temporary Ancona 6N network. The deployment followed the November 2022 magnitude-5.5 Adriatic event and monitored the subsequent sequence. Station CMA15 serves as the reference site. Public text files contain comma-separated columns for frequency, the average station-to-reference ratio and one-standard-deviation bounds. Zenodo licenses the deposit as CC-BY-4.0, with free access and reuse subject to attribution. A limitation is that the inferred relative amplification depends on the reference station and the sampled earthquakes. These ratios should not be treated as independent measurements of absolute shaking intensity. They can help calibrate site-response terms in urban seismic simulations. The deposit complements horizontal-to-vertical ratios from the same network with a different comparison method and links to the underlying waveform archive. Numerical spectra and their uncertainty were not independently recalculated. Coverage is limited to Ancona.
